svg.text: Reverse-engineering workstation — carved malware, opened with no network at all
Staging is the only step with store access, a session is granted exactly one host, and the determination travels back through the ANALYST — there is no wire it could take.
ENCLAVE
STAGING — the only step holding credentials
ISOLATED — no network namespace exists
Analysis sandbox (worker)
per-process YARA pass CARVES suspicious regions
out of the memory image during analysis
no egress · the carve is recorded on the capture
provenance kept: injected / mapped / non-executable
MinIO — ir-carved-<host>
ONE BUCKET PER HOST, kept apart from ir-evidence
a session is granted one host's bucket and can
see no other case · reachable only through the
mesh sidecar, like every data-tier service
Investigation record (Django API)
a determination lands as a FINDING on the run the
capture came from · region.analyze / region.purge audited
stage_regions.sh — MEDIATOR
holds the store credentials so the session never does
one host per invocation · writes each region 0400
manifest carries object KEYS, never payloads —
nothing in the session can find its way back to the store
a session over ZERO regions is refused: an empty
session is indistinguishable from a broken one
launch.sh
tool narrowest-first: --tool, then IR_RE_TOOL, then the
deployment default · containment identical either way
RE workstation — Binary Ninja / Ghidra
--network none: not a firewall rule, an ABSENCE —
network exists only while the image is BUILT
CapEff = 0 · non-root · /regions mounted read-only
no license server, activation or call-home needed
display over the host's Wayland/X socket only
session-<host> workdir on the host — carved process
memory, never published, excluded from the mirror
The RE analyst
reads the disassembly here; records the determination in the
platform UI as their RE role — a person, not a connection
carve → per-host bucket
stage (one host,
credentials stay here)
open
the determination: recorded by the PERSON through the SSO gate — the workstation has no path
PURGE — a benign region's bytes are deleted; the determination that justified deleting them is kept
region.purge removes the payload from the carved bucket and the session, audited with the actor and the reason · the conclusion outlives the
material, which is the point: malware is retained only while it is being asked something
Proven by:
uat_re_workstation.sh — no network namespace, CapEff 0, read-only regions, store unreachable from the session, refusal over zero regions;
uat_e2e.sh — collect → analyze → carve → stage → determine, end to end; uat_schema.sh — purge keeps the conclusions
Detail:
re-workstation/README.md — containment table, session flow, display, Ghidra's divergence
